summary: Iteration 63 - Social Media Workflows Phase 1. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing completed successfully for: Approval Workflows page, Posting Queues page, Posts & Schedule with recurring indicator, and Post Version History modal. Fixed bug in PostsAndSchedule.jsx where API calls had duplicate /api prefix.

fixed_issues.issue: API calls had duplicate /api prefix (e.g., /api/api/social/posts instead of /social/posts)
fixed_issues.fix: Removed /api prefix from all API calls in fetchPosts, handleSubmit, handleDeletePost, handlePublishPost functions

critical_code_review_comments: All Phase 1 API endpoints working: approval-chains CRUD, queues CRUD, post versions CRUD, seed-defaults
Frontend pages load correctly with data-testid attributes present
Recurring post indicator displays correctly on calendar and list views
Version History modal opens from post detail panel and shows proper empty state
seed_data_creation: Default approval workflow and posting queues were seeded via /api/social/workflows/seed-defaults
